cases.originalAssertion: 给定目标与相应权限，执行“收纳已结束计划”后核对：仅已结束且未收纳的计划追加收纳记录，历史保留
cases.evidenceMeaning: Dismiss appends the collection record only for an ended-and-not-collected panel; history entries remain readable, a second dismiss is an idempotent no-op that does not append.

cases.originalAssertion: 输入无效、权限不足或下游失败时应返回明确错误，不呈现成功结果
cases.evidenceMeaning: Explicit rejections mirror the family gates; dismiss has no streaming gate by incumbent TS semantics (asserted directly).

cases.originalAssertion: 给定目标与相应权限，执行“清扫孤儿工作台会话”后核对：把挂载已移除或实际目录不存在的会话归档，跳过运行中会话并上报错误
cases.evidenceMeaning: Sweep archives exactly the two orphan kinds (mount removed from the active registry set, or cwd directory gone from disk), keeps non-orphans untouched, skips streaming orphans, and falls back to default-only when the registry is missing or corrupt (never mis-archives).

cases.originalAssertion: 输入无效、权限不足或下游失败时应返回明确错误，不呈现成功结果
cases.evidenceMeaning: Unauthenticated 401; foreign principals never see or touch other principals' sessions in the scanned/matched sets.

cases.originalAssertion: 给定目标与相应权限，执行“归档工作台会话”后核对：符合工作台身份的会话移到可恢复归档
cases.evidenceMeaning: Workspace disposal with action=archive matches sessions by workspaceMountId or normalized cwd and moves each matched non-streaming session into the recoverable archived lifecycle.

cases.originalAssertion: 输入无效、权限不足或下游失败时应返回明确错误，不呈现成功结果
cases.evidenceMeaning: Missing identity 400 (missing_workspace_identity), unauthenticated 401, busy sessions skipped with counts, per-session failures collected into errors without interrupting the batch.

cases.originalAssertion: 执行“删除工作区技能目录”后核对：只允许当前工作区已知技能目录；递归删除后重新同步目录，失败返回错误
cases.evidenceMeaning: Delete only accepts directories inside the known workspace skill roots; a successful recursive delete re-syncs the directory listing.

cases.originalAssertion: 失败、冲突或拒绝时核对返回的状态与实际副作用一致
cases.evidenceMeaning: Rejections (unknown/escaping targets, missing credentials) leave the skill tree and disk state byte-identical.

cases.originalAssertion: 键目录与get一致
cases.evidenceMeaning: The list payload equals per-key get payloads for every key (same names, same values).

cases.originalAssertion: 模型/会话值与运行时一致
cases.evidenceMeaning: Model/session values come from the live focus config and real session-file/subagent registries.

cases.originalAssertion: 未知值标未知
cases.evidenceMeaning: Unknown values surface as explicit null/empty, never fabricated.

cases.originalAssertion: 未知key或依赖不可用返回明确状态/错误，不能猜造供应商结果。
cases.evidenceMeaning: Unknown key 400 with a visible error; unreadable model config yields explicit null instead of a guessed provider result.

cases.originalAssertion: 准备请求助手 A、焦点助手 B（A≠B）并执行 PUT /api/agents/:id/config 删除：读回 provider-catalog.json；纯供应商成功刷新可重写 B 的 config.yaml，但不经请求 A 的显式保存；A=B 时按同一焦点路径核对。
cases.evidenceMeaning: Provider delete removes the overlay entry from provider-catalog.json and refreshes the focus agent's projection without touching the requested agent's explicit YAML.

cases.originalAssertion: 仅本地自定义或未注册插件保存才写 provider-plugins；仅删除本地插件才删文件。内置覆盖项删除后内置声明仍在；不存在的条目删除可不改目录。
cases.evidenceMeaning: Local plugin deletions remove the plugin files and record meta.deletedProviders; built-in deletions keep the built-in declaration; deleting what is absent in both catalog and plugins returns early with no file changes.

cases.originalAssertion: models.json 只是派生投影，内容不变且权限正确可不重写；供应商用户数据以 provider-catalog.json 为准。
cases.evidenceMeaning: models.json stays a derived projection with the no-rewrite rule asserted.

cases.originalAssertion: onProviderChanged 或后续焦点刷新失败时，先前目录/插件文件可能已变而 HTTP 报错；无焦点时无 ID 刷新可失败，不宣称原子回滚，并逐处读回。
cases.evidenceMeaning: Partial success on later-segment failures is preserved and reported; no atomic rollback claim.

cases.originalAssertion: 同请求多供应商项逐项处理，后项失败可保留前项；只有另含全局字段才写 preferences.json，不写人格或记忆文件。
cases.evidenceMeaning: Item-by-item processing and preferences-only-when-global-fields rules asserted.

cases.originalAssertion: 执行“删除记忆缓存观察记录”后核对：校验 settings.write 范围后删除当前 Agent 观察记录，返回 deleted 状态
cases.evidenceMeaning: DELETE unlinks the real latest.json under the settings.write gate and returns {ok:true, deleted:true}; ENOENT returns deleted:false as success semantics.

cases.originalAssertion: 失败、冲突或拒绝时核对返回的状态与实际副作用一致
cases.evidenceMeaning: Missing/escaping agentId 400, unauthenticated 401; the read face reports null after deletion and repeated deletes are idempotent.

cases.originalAssertion: 给定目标与相应权限，执行“完成当前计划余项”后核对：有未完成项时追加完成记录并广播；已完成时返回当前面板不重复写
cases.evidenceMeaning: Complete appends the completion record only while unfinished items exist (completedTodos snapshot) and broadcasts todos-changed; a second complete returns the current panel without appending.

cases.originalAssertion: 输入无效、权限不足或下游失败时应返回明确错误，不呈现成功结果
cases.evidenceMeaning: Missing sessionId 400, unknown session 404, archived 409, unauthenticated 401, streaming 409 and version-mismatch 409 (todo_version_mismatch) are all explicit rejections.

cases.originalAssertion: 给定目标与相应权限，执行“取消当前计划余项”后核对：有未完成项时追加取消记录并广播，不终止其他后台任务
cases.evidenceMeaning: Cancel appends the cancel record for non-terminal items only and broadcasts todos-changed; terminal items stay untouched and other sessions' panels are unaffected (cancel has no run/background termination surface — isolation is asserted cross-session).

cases.originalAssertion: 输入无效、权限不足或下游失败时应返回明确错误，不呈现成功结果
cases.evidenceMeaning: Same explicit gate vocabulary as complete: 400/404/409 busy/409 archived/409 version/401.

cases.originalAssertion: 准备请求助手 A、焦点助手 B（A≠B）并执行 PUT /api/agents/:id/config 保存：读回 provider-catalog.json；纯供应商成功刷新可重写 B 的 config.yaml，但不经请求 A 的显式保存；A=B 时按同一焦点路径核对。
cases.evidenceMeaning: Provider save reads back provider-catalog.json; a pure provider success refreshes the focus agent's config.yaml while the requested agent A's explicit YAML stays untouched.

cases.originalAssertion: 仅本地自定义或未注册插件保存才写 provider-plugins；内置供应商不因此写插件文件。
cases.evidenceMeaning: Only local custom/unregistered plugins write provider-plugins files; built-in providers never do; deleting a built-in overlay keeps the built-in declaration; deleting an absent entry leaves the catalog unchanged.

cases.originalAssertion: models.json 只是派生投影，内容不变且权限正确可不重写；供应商用户数据以 provider-catalog.json 为准。
cases.evidenceMeaning: models.json is a derived projection — unchanged content with correct permissions is not rewritten (mtime asserted).

cases.originalAssertion: onProviderChanged 或后续焦点刷新失败时，先前目录/插件文件可能已变而 HTTP 报错；无焦点时无 ID 刷新可失败，不宣称原子回滚，并逐处读回。
cases.evidenceMeaning: A later-segment failure returns 500 while earlier catalog/plugin writes persist — no atomic-rollback claim; a missing focus agent makes the refresh fail explicitly.

cases.originalAssertion: 同请求多供应商项逐项处理，后项失败可保留前项；只有另含全局字段才写 preferences.json，不写人格或记忆文件。
cases.evidenceMeaning: Multiple providers in one request process item by item (later failure keeps earlier entries); a pure provider request writes no preferences and never touches persona/memory files.

cases.originalAssertion: 成功时核对：返回已解析实验与有效值
cases.evidenceMeaning: GET /experiments returns the four registered experiments with their effective values (retired -> off, defaults applied).

cases.originalAssertion: 拒绝/无效输入时核对：无越权或错误持久化，且错误对用户可见
cases.evidenceMeaning: Reads never persist; errors are user-visible.

cases.originalAssertion: 成功时核对：返回指定智能体 observation
cases.evidenceMeaning: GET returns the agent's normalized observation from agents/<id>/experiments/cache-snapshot-reflection/latest.json; a missing file yields observation:null without 404.

cases.originalAssertion: 拒绝/无效输入时核对：无越权或错误持久化，且错误对用户可见
cases.evidenceMeaning: Missing/escaping agentId 400, corrupt/array bodies 400 with visible errors; the read leaves the file bytes unchanged.

cases.originalAssertion: 成功时核对：保存已注册实验的 value 并返回生效值
cases.evidenceMeaning: PATCH saves a registered experiment's value (enum/boolean normalized) into preferences.experiments and returns the effective value.

cases.originalAssertion: 拒绝/无效输入时核对：无越权或错误持久化，且错误对用户可见
cases.evidenceMeaning: Unregistered id 400 and invalid values reject with zero persistence (preference bytes compared).

cases.originalAssertion: 成功：执行“导出技能组合包”后，构建可下载组合包及结果元数据
cases.evidenceMeaning: Export builds a real store-mode zip (unzip-verified) containing skills/<name>/ plus bundle.json metadata and returns the result metadata with the unique output name.

cases.originalAssertion: 拒绝/边界：id 不存在/打包失败明确错误；不应错误扩大写入或披露范围
cases.evidenceMeaning: Missing bundle/skill entries, corrupt bundle storage and empty exportable sets reject explicitly; a rejected export never rewrites the bundle store or expands writes.

note: 仅已审阅的逐断言证据由本轮原始日志重算；缺少映射的原义务仍由阶段门禁保持BLOCKED。
